title: Oliver's band at Abadie's: Richard M. Jones and Ernest Rogers
summary: Who was in the band with Oliver at Abadie's: Richard M. Jones, drummer Ernest Rogers, and what became of that band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who else was in the band when Oliver was there at Abedee's? Who else? Do you remember? Was it Richard M Jones?
Oh yeah. Miney, Miney's name was, we used to call him Miney. Miney Jones. Joseph Jones.
Why did they call him Miney? I never knew.
I don't know. We used to call him Miney all the time.
Somebody said once, you know, when I knew him in Chicago, he used to limp a little bit. Yeah, yeah. Did he always limp too? Yeah.
Maybe there's something about his knee then, you think? Or was that... I don't know. It wasn't about that. There was something else he used to call me.
I never did know why. Somebody told me it was because of his knee that he limp. I didn't know. I didn't think it would be that, but I wondered.
Him and Tiff went together then, did they?
Who was the drummer? Do you remember?

Oh, Ernest Rogers. You know, he died, didn't you? Yes. In the short time. Yes. In September. I wanted to go to see him. I didn't know he did till the way after. I went to the funeral, but I didn't see him before. I'm sorry I didn't. Big strong looking, help the fella. Yeah.

Ernest Rogers did. That whole band is gone. What used to play there on Ronald Cronin. Ernest Rogers. I don't see how it's done. I don't get nothing about him anymore. The last Cronin that was playing there. I believe Charlie loved playing Cronin tonight.
Oh, yes. Charlie was playing there. He had his teeth pulled out this spring too, but I think he had his teeth this time.
Oh, yes. Oh, yes. Pete was playing there. Peter Boccage. He must have put it, given up, you know.
